units.description: Admit narrow ADR amendments and implementation contracts; freeze data ownership and interface versions.
Harden optional semantic persistence, identity, evidence states and server-side dormancy.
Implement truthful scoped backfill and durable commit-bound projection operations.
Wire one optional Odoo integration bridge to native opportunity sources, EIE and CEG.
Add native read-only review and explicit CRM handoff without duplicate commercial lifecycle.
Complete integrated tests, optional Enterprise lane, migration/recovery and independent review.
Operator-only phased activation and monitored recovery; disabled until separately authorized.
